profile.headline: Escalations Engineer for the Enterprise Networking Group at Cisco
profile.summary: A seasoned Field Applications Engineer with 10+ years experience in the networking and telecommunications industry.  Proven ability to maintain relationships and increase share of product at key customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Escalations
positions.description:
*  Manage escalations for the ASR1k, ISR, CSR, ENCS, CSP product lines, and provide single point of contact for critical customers 
*  Built test beds in the lab to recreate issues for routing, crypto, LTE, and virtual platforms
*  Developed presentations for the DRAM memory issue impacting multiple product lines, and delivered the training to central teams to allow quicker remediation for Cisco customers

positions.title: Senior Field Applications Engineer
positions.description:
• Qualified product for deployment in service provider labs worldwide
• Pre-sales support for VDSL2 Node Scale Vectoring, Bonding and SmartCPE
• Demonstrated product features, trained customers on tools, debugged customer designs, and gathered feedback for product improvement
• Assist key customers bringing VDSL2, ADSL2/2+, and SHDSL to production for Central Office and CPE
• Expertise with all aspects of the residential gateway: DSL, bridging, routing, voice, wifi
• Worked with product marketing, applications, and sales to coordinate response to AVDSL RFI
